name: F1 Racing Store MCP
description: Full agentic access to the F1 Racing Store. Query tickets, merchandise, calendar, and experiences — or perform human-like actions: navigate pages, search products, manage a shopping cart, and complete checkout. All in one MCP server.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Navigate to any page (home, merchandise, tickets, cart, checkout, experiences, calendar) and get page context + available next actions

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Keyword search across all merchandise, tickets, and experiences — returns product IDs for add_to_cart

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full details for a single product by ID

tools.name: get_cart_token
tools.description: Start a new empty cart and get a cart_token for your shopping session

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add any product to the cart by ID — simulates clicking Add to Cart on the site

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: View all cart items, quantities, subtotal, tax, shipping, and order total

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Change item quantity or remove item (quantity=0) from the cart

tools.name: begin_checkout
tools.description: Start checkout — validates cart and returns the form schema required for submit_order

tools.name: submit_order
tools.description: Complete the purchase with shipping + payment details — returns confirmed order ID

tools.name: get_tickets
tools.description: Query race tickets with pricing, categories, and availability — filter by race or category

tools.name: get_merchandise
tools.description: Browse team apparel, accessories, and collectibles — filter by team or category

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Get the 2026 F1 race calendar with circuits and dates

tools.name: get_experiences
tools.description: Get VIP hospitality, pit lane, and exclusive F1 experiences
